summary: Revised Emergency Production Catalog & Admin Access Recovery Plan (Plan 14) incorporating the Owner's four mandatory acceptance criteria: 1) Instant live publishing of new templates & hero banners on Public Website without rebuild/redeploy, 2) Strict cryptographic Firebase ID Token verification rejecting client req.body.email bypass, 3) Explicit three-state catalogue handling (OFFLINE/DEGRADED vs EMPTY vs READY) with zero seed fallback in production, and 4) Single server-side authoritative admin allowlist with permanent regression tests.
